title: Hero photos on the home, North County and city pages are found late or served raw

source.ref: SEO, GEO and speed deep scan 2026-11-19 (production crawl of 3,000 URLs, all 720 sitemap pages, 8 crawler user agents, Lighthouse on 14 templates)

detail: The home page serves six /brand/frequency/photos/sm/*.jpg files as plain img (195 to 247 KB could be saved with modern formats and right sizes) and carries one 36 KB image inlined as base64 in the document. /north-county-san-diego and /discover/cities/ draw their hero as a background with no preload, so the browser waits 1.2 to 1.7 s before asking for it. The first visit to a cold city or market page takes 2 to 5 s on the server and is fast afterwards. Re-tested 2026-11-20. Heroes: DxHero (North County, every city page) already preloads its still from the HTML through PhotoBgPreload (SCAN-1265), at the rendition and breakpoint the CSS background picks. Inlined image: production / fetched 2026-11-20 holds no data: URI at all (292,878 characters, 0 base64), so that item is gone. Cold city render: the city pages are ISR (revalidate 3600, dense cities prebuilt), and PERF-040 (merged 2026-11-20) moved the density read off the time-zone scan that made a cold render slow. Fix here: the home fold photos offer a 360px WebP through (a phone 180px slot at 2x), 103 KB for all six against 264 KB at the 640px JPEG; the keeps its JPEG set (home-fold-phone probe unchanged). Static files cut with sharp, never the paid optimizer.

verify.note: Fails on main: no 360px WebP for the fold photos. Passes when the fold offers it through <picture>, each file exists under 30 KB, and North County and city heroes go through the preloading DxHero.
